additional_info.subject: proactive-ID0367363-DC/Si-D/FI-[AZNNJA] - DC_Coils_MG2-MG4_QA11-12 & CableTempIssue CRM:00315001562
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
A quick update on the CableTempSensor error. From our perspective, I cannot recommend to replace a cable with more than 10 occurrences, this was aligned with Product Champion as it would be massive in costs. First we need to make an assessment of the plug and go from there. It's up to you if you want to take a spare one or not, for the ones that have few occurrences, since (in this case) it occurred only once per week (for DC2). For DC1 it's clear to me that we should order a new CCS cable. But we still need to make a visual inspection of the CCS before replacement and make wiring checks.
In sum, from TechSupport:
1 CCS cable
QA11-12
Thank you for understanding.
Best regards,
Francisco
